about_home.body: CHAP & CO is an Ivorian company founded in 2023, specializing in the structuring and export of agricultural raw materials from West Africa. We connect local producers with major global market players — industrialists, distributors, and processors.
about_home.quote: Our ambition: to build lasting partnerships with global market leaders.

about_hero.title:
Africa as our foundation,

the world as our horizon.
about_hero.subtitle: An Ivorian company specializing in the structuring and export of agricultural raw materials from West Africa to the world.

our_story.title:
A clear vision,

a global ambition.
our_story.paragraph_1: Founded in 2023 in Abidjan, CHAP & CO was born from the conviction that West Africa, rich in its terroir and producers, deserves a professional and rigorous interface to shine on international markets.
our_story.paragraph_2: Our role: structuring exports of agricultural and food raw materials while guaranteeing quality, traceability and compliance — from Ivorian fields to European, Asian and American ports.

mission_vision.title: What drives us.
mission_vision.mission_body: To be the strategic bridge between local producers of West Africa and the industrialists, distributors and processors of the global market.
mission_vision.mission_point_1: Connect local producers with local industrialists
mission_vision.mission_point_2: Connect local producers with international industrialists
mission_vision.ambition_quote: To establish lasting partnerships with major players in the global market.

positioning.title: At the heart of the value chain.
positioning.body: We orchestrate the meeting between African terroirs and international markets.
positioning.col1_desc: Supply chains rigorously selected in West Africa

market_opportunity.title:
A global market

in full growth.
market_opportunity.body: CHAP & CO is positioned within a worldwide dynamic favourable to high-potential African products.
market_opportunity.quote: CHAP & CO is part of this dynamic by offering high-potential African products, adapted to global distribution networks.
market_opportunity.trend_1_desc: Continuous growth in global demand for authentic African terroir products.
market_opportunity.trend_2_desc: Strong demand for natural, unprocessed, nutrient-rich products.
market_opportunity.trend_3_desc: Manufacturers seek to diversify their sourcing origins to secure their supply chains.
market_opportunity.trend_4_desc: Growing interest in gluten-free alternatives — cassava, hibiscus, shea.

founder.name: Cedric Messou
founder.title: Founder & CEO
founder.body_1: At the helm of CHAP & CO since its founding in 2023, Cedric Messou carries a clear vision: to make African terroir a global reference in agricultural and food raw materials.
founder.body_2: His dual knowledge of Ivorian supply chains and international market requirements allows him to orchestrate a rigorous export chain, where every link — from producer to container — is under control.

contact.hero_title: Let's build your supply chain together.
contact.hero_subtitle: Quote, samples, quality dossier or simply a conversation — we respond within 48 working hours.
contact.coords_body: For any urgent request or informal discussion, feel free to call or write to us.
contact.reactivity_body: Every enquiry received is handled within 48 working hours. For urgent matters, we recommend calling us directly.
contact.form_message_placeholder: Describe your needs, volumes, destination market...
contact.form_gdpr: I agree that my data may be used by CHAP & CO to process my enquiry. In accordance with GDPR, you may request deletion of your data at any time.
contact.form_success_desc: We will get back to you within 48 working hours.
contact.form_error_desc: Please try again or contact us directly by phone.
contact.faq_title: Everything you need to know before reaching out.
contact.faq_q1: How quickly do you respond to enquiries?
contact.faq_a1: Every enquiry submitted via our form is handled within 48 working hours. For urgent requests, we recommend calling us directly at +225 07 04 76 76 76.
contact.faq_q2: Can I receive a sample before placing an order?
contact.faq_a2: Yes, we send samples on request to allow our partners to evaluate the quality of our products. Shipping costs may be charged depending on the volume requested.
contact.faq_q3: What documents do you provide for export?
contact.faq_a3: We provide according to your requirements: phytosanitary certificate, certificate of origin, microbiological analyses, product technical sheets, and all customs documentation.
contact.faq_a4: We offer two modes: FOB Abidjan (delivery at the port of loading) and CIF European ports (Marseille, Antwerp, Rotterdam — cost, insurance and freight included). Other incoterms can be considered depending on your needs.
contact.cta_title: Explore our range of nine supply chains.
contact.cta_body: Discover each of our products in detail, their derivatives and applications in our online product sheets.

quality.hero_title: Rigour at the service of your confidence.
quality.hero_subtitle: From supply chain selection to export documentation, every step is designed to meet the demands of international markets.
quality.commitment_title: Total traceability, from farm to container.
quality.commitment_body_1: At CHAP & CO, quality is not optional: it is a method. Every product that leaves the port of Abidjan has been selected, checked and documented to rigorous standards.
quality.commitment_body_2: Our objective is the progressive alignment with European food safety standards — a mark of seriousness for our international partners.
quality.commitment_quote: Our objective is the progressive alignment with European food safety standards.
quality.process_step_1_desc: Visits to partner supply chains, verification of production and harvest conditions.
quality.process_step_2_desc: Visual inspection of products: appearance, calibration, moisture, integrity, absence of foreign matter.
quality.process_step_3_desc: Microbiological and chemical analyses to ensure health compliance.
quality.process_step_4_desc: Bagging, containerisation or bulk according to client requirements, with compliant labelling.
quality.process_step_5_desc: Issuing of certificates, product sheets and customs documents for the destination country.
quality.process_step_6_desc: Final check before loading: sealing, marking, handover of documents to the carrier.
quality.docs_title: Five documents for your peace of mind.
quality.docs_body: According to your market requirements and the specifics of your order.
quality.docs_footer: Additional specific certifications may be provided on request, depending on your market and particular requirements.
quality.doc_1_desc: Official document attesting that the product is free from pests and meets the sanitary requirements of the importing country.
quality.doc_2_desc: Attests to the Ivorian origin of the product, essential for customs formalities and trade agreements.
quality.doc_3_desc: Laboratory tests verifying the absence of microbial contamination and compliance with food safety standards.
quality.doc_4_desc: Detailed characteristics: composition, packaging, storage methods, nutritional values.
quality.doc_5_desc: Complete dossier for customs clearance: invoices, packing lists, export declarations.
quality.standards_title: From Africa to Europe, with the same demands.
quality.standards_body: Our objective is the progressive alignment with European standards in food safety and industrial compliance.
quality.standards_col1_desc: Rigorous sourcing from Ivorian and West African supply chains
quality.standards_col3_desc: Compliance with European and international standards
quality.cta_body: Specify your product, destination market and specific requirements — we prepare a tailored compliance dossier.

logistics.hero_title: From Abidjan to the world's ports.
logistics.hero_subtitle: Secure maritime transport, rigorous planning, and full support across the entire logistics chain.
logistics.process_quote: Maritime transport in secure containers, volume planning per contract — every shipment is a commitment.
logistics.process_step_1_desc: Definition of volumes, packaging and shipping schedule according to your contract.
logistics.process_step_2_desc: Loading into secure containers, sealing and pre-shipment verification at the port of Abidjan.
logistics.process_step_3_desc: Loading on vessel, document tracking and coordination with your consignee.
logistics.process_step_4_desc: Coordination with your freight forwarder at the destination port for handover.
logistics.fob_desc: Free On Board — You take delivery of the goods once loaded on the vessel at the port of Abidjan.
logistics.fob_point_2: Transport handled from your end on arrival
logistics.fob_point_3: Ideal for buyers with their own logistics
logistics.cif_desc: Cost, Insurance, Freight — We cover the cost, insurance and freight to the destination port.
logistics.cif_point_3: Ideal for importers without maritime logistics
logistics.cif_point_4: Maximum peace of mind to the arrival port
logistics.modes_footer: Other incoterms (CFR, EXW) or destinations can be considered depending on your needs. Contact us to discuss your specific situation.
logistics.proposals_title: Five commitments for your supply chain.
logistics.proposal_1_desc: Selection of products best suited to your market and distribution channels.
logistics.proposal_2_desc: Packaging under your brand for retail distribution or specialist retailers.
logistics.proposal_3_desc: Volumes planned annually, negotiated prices, supply chain security.
logistics.proposal_4_desc: Before any commitment, receive samples and all product documentation.
logistics.proposal_5_desc: Beyond the transaction, we build lasting relationships with our partners.
logistics.dest_body: Our main destination ports, with other options on request depending on your market.
logistics.cta_title: A presentation meeting, a pricing study.
logistics.cta_body: We are available to organise a presentation meeting and produce a pricing study tailored to your volumes and destinations.
